853:t_127:13.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Heh heh... Sorry, but I saw through your sexual harassment scheme a long time ago.」

853:t_127:14.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「If you still insist on going through with it, then not just the $$ＳＲＴ$$... the entire crew of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ will deal with you.」

853:t_127:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Superb tactical insight, and the charisma to command a pack of rough men... Ah, Miss $$テッサ$$... you are so far out of my reach...」

853:t_128:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$ダヤッカ$$!」

853:t_128:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It must have been rough for everyone on $$超銀河ダイグレン$$. Being shut away in another dimension the whole time.」

853:t_128:6.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「That's what I wanted to tell you about, so listen! $$アンネ$$ grew up while I was gone!」

853:t_128:7.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Maybe because $$キヨウ$$ taught her so well, she learned the word 'Daddy' even without me around!」

853:t_128:8.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「And that's not all! She must get her stamina from me, because she looks like she'll start running any day now! She's just so cute, so cute...」

853:t_128:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Speak your fill, Mr. $$ダヤッカ$$... I have no intention of being so tactless as to point out that this has nothing to do with celebrating an ace pilot.)

853:t_128:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I'll keep you company for as long as AG's spirit holds out. Though I expect that's about three more minutes...)

853:t_129:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Miss $$トライア$$!」

853:t_129:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「No need for the extra courtesy. This is your achievement too.」

853:t_129:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you very much, Miss $$トライア$$!」

853:t_129:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've been treated coldly the whole time in $c, but you're the one exception, Miss $$トライア$$!」

853:t_129:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「Of course... I'm practically your accomplice, after all.」

853:t_129:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-wait, you make me sound like a criminal...」

853:t_129:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「If you don't want people thinking that, get to work. If we don't try a lot harder, Earth and space are both finished.」

853:t_129:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood! I'll give it my all again today... business, business!」
